comment_en: Yesterday's record was 123 wins, 91 losses, and 7 draws, resulting in 📉12,950 yen in losses at 1,000 yen per bet. On the other hand, the Brentford O/U 2.5 Under at odds of 2.06 stood out as a 💰1,060 yen return. The cumulative record across 2,544 bets sits at a 56.8% win rate with a -3.9% return on stakes.
